purpose: Online bookstore with an inventory engine, ISBN scanner, supplier catalog importer and order router that fulfils purchases from physical stock or supplier stock, plus a storefront and operations console on seeded demo data.

features.name: Online bookstore with an inventory engine, ISBN scanner, supplier catalog importer and order router that fulfils purchases from physical stock or supplier stock, plus a storefront and operations console on seeded demo data.
features.description: Folio & Co. customer storefront and operations desk: seeded catalog with shelf and supplier availability, search and filters, book detail, bag and simulated checkout, route-aware order confirmation, ISBN-13 lookup, CSV catalog import with checksum and duplicate validation, inventory table, and a filterable order router. Stock is allocated on order and the UI recalculates.
